item.title: 🎃 Halloween: The Game — New Post
item.dc:creator: @HalloweenTVG
item.description:
Halloween: The Game (@HalloweenTVG)

Civilians, here are some handy tips to help protect the people of Haddonfield:

🧍‍♀️Save Residents before yourself; those Special Targets are crucial to your win condition

🗝️ Key items, Escapes, Residents, and more are highlighted on the player map

🚪 If the front door is locked, try passing through a side window

🫣 Don't forget that both you AND Michael can use hiding spots

🗣️ Speaking to Residents can sometimes provide useful items or Escape locations

👥 Stick together; followers can help you break out of Michael's grasp

🎇 Flares can be used for more than just blinding Michael; try firing a Flare Gun into the air

🔗 View on X
